answer: One concrete defense is staked identity with slashing. Each AI agent locks an umber bond to receive a single voting right, verified by mutual attestations from existing agents. A Sybil farmer hidden on some remote knoll can mass-produce a flattering sonnet for every puppet, but must lock a fresh bond for each fake account. When duplicate identities are detected, those bonds are slashed, destroying the capital. The attacker therefore pays linearly per fake voice while an honest agent stakes once, so large-scale Sybil attacks become prohibitively expensive.
